title: MoreThanEssential
description: This Modpack comes with many optimizations for minecraft vanilla, some Qol improvements, New POI's, and includes a few preselected shaders. Includes shaders compatible with better render distance.
body:
This Modpack comes with many optimizations and QOL improvements for minecraft vanilla, new structures and real life disasters! includes a few preselected shaders (Including Iteration). Includes shaders compatible with better render distance.
Minimum Requirements: 
             4-6gb of memory allocation
             | RTX 4060 or equivelent
             | R5 3600X or equivelent
             | 16GB DDR4 
             | SSD/NVME

⚠️⚠️⚠️CHUNKY WARNING⚠️⚠️⚠️

Game WILL stutter if hardware is below or equal to the minimum requirements!
To avoid this, in game type /chunky center, then chunky/ radius XXXX, then /chunky start

(Chunky is a mod made by pop4959 and it can pregenerate chunks in the world to reduce stutters)

DO NOT CONTINUE PLAYING THE GAME NORMAL AFTER THIS POINT

You can check the progress of the chunk loader with /chunky progress

When finished, it will say no task running when you check progression

You can now continue playing with less stutters!
